profile.headline: Software Engineer | STEM Educator
profile.summary:
I am a teacher and software engineer experienced in creating full-stack web applications. I enjoy working with React, Node, and SQL. Passion for useful math, EdTech, Green tech, and tech that solves problems.

Latest open source product I've worked on is Neo, a developer tool for measuring SEO metrics on pre-deployed Next.js projects. Recently I was invited to give a talk on the "Benefits of Server-Side Rendering (SSR)" for the Jeeny and Bractlet Speaker Series.

When not looking at a screen, I love to go to Angels games, teach/perform dance, play music, and spend time with my daughters.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leveraged Next.js tooling with Puppeteer to implement headless server capabilities, serving a dockerized container of a pre-deployed project, allowing for the extraction and display of essential browser data and loading metrics
• Incorporated JSZip with File API to convert Next.js projects into a compressed Binary Large Object (“blob”), resulting in 50% reduction of file size and transfer time to the backend, reduced network overhead, and simplified resource utilization
• Configured Node/Express middleware alongside Chart.js for real-time metric analysis, using a novel algorithm for data normalization and serving responsive chart data to client’s dashboard
• Delivered a scalable and secure solution for uploading, analyzing, and interacting with client projects by integrating RESTful APIs with Next-Connect Router and the fs-extra utility library
• Employed Jest’s built-in support for Next.js projects to perform testing on asynchronous operations and integration with Puppeteer 
• Used PostgreSQL database to manage anticipated application complexity, handle concurrent read/write operations, and establish a reliable foundation for maintaining data integrity
• Accelerated by OS Labs (https://www.opensourcelabs.io/)

positions.title: Software Engineer | LifeHacks
positions.description:
A dynamic forum for sharing life hacks
• Built with React to create an interactive UI using modular and reusable components for simplified debugging and maintainable code
• Improved application reliability by integrating a Node/Express backend with a PostgreSQL database to scale with large datasets
• Synchronized state hooks with database to introduce upvoting/downvoting functionalities for user-generated content
• Implemented OAuth 2.0 to enable Single Sign-On using OAuth protocol flows for seamless user account creation, login, and simplified credential management
• Customized webpack configuration for efficient bundling of JavaScript and CSS files, reducing file requests and optimizing page performance

positions.title: Math Teacher
positions.description:
• Transposed curriculum to online platforms (Google Sites, Nearpod), applying UI/UX principles to curate developmentally appropriate learning experiences
• Utilized educational technologies such as Aeries, Powerschool, Google Classroom, Google Sites, Docs, Sheets, and more, to provide timely feedback, enhance student engagement, and facilitate learning
• Facilitated professional development for school faculty with Math Department; on the topic: “Building Interdisciplinary Math Agency”
• Taught 120-150 students each school day; consistently raised achievement scores for students in LEAP, ACT, and CAASPP state testing; growth rating: “Proficient”
positions.insights: Public Speaking, Curriculum Design and +1 skill

positions.title: Solar Permit Specialist
positions.locationName: Orange County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Prepared and submitted CADs (Computer-Aided Designs) for residential solar construction projects, adhering to strict requirements of Building and Safety Departments in various Southern California cities
• Engaged in technical discussions with civil engineers to ensure compliance with each city’s unique permit regulations, and securing essential approvals for successful project execution
positions.insights: Computer-Aided Design (CAD), Solar Systems and +1 skill

volunteerExperiences.description: Organized workflow for a group of 15 UCLA students to paint a blacktop mural of the United States; delegated responsibilities based on students' strengths and competence; encouraged teamwork and camaraderie to create a friendlier work environment.
